name: Marching Cubes with Contraction
aliases: Unbounded TSDF Mesh Extraction with Contraction
definition: Extracts a 3D mesh from a Signed Distance Field (SDF) using the Marching Cubes algorithm, processing the volume in chunks to manage memory, and applying an inverse contraction transformation to the vertices.
summary: Marching Cubes with Contraction extracts 3D meshes from signed distance fields by processing unbounded scenes in fixed-size chunks and applying inverse contraction to avoid global grid memory limits.
